text_block_list.text: Gold City blazes across turf, golden hair gleaming beneath sunset glow. Total serious look on face.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Finish line...! *pant*, *pant*...! T-Time! What's my clocking...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: For real?... Ahaha, no way, legit. I can actually pull this off...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, stop. Overdoing the praise. Still... whoa, unreal...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Sometimes way too much, annoying, zero delicacy, flat-out irritating...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still, trainer gig might legit be your calling. True vocation type deal.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, slack off and you're done for, got it? Haven't fully acknowledged you yet.
choice_data_list: I’ll do my best to keep you from abandoning me

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Told you, over the top! Ahaha! Alright, hit gym after this, lower body till dark—

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Manager? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Hate cutting in on practice. Emergency, though! Massive gig landed!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, apologies! Wrapping up today's practice right here!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hold up! Don't just decide stuff! Still got tons on my schedule!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Please, step away. It's about your entire future...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: About my... future?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Turned out just some stand-in gig. Tons of top-tier models around, I'm just bench replacement.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Did work properly, obviously. Never cut corners.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then manager rolls up... “Safe, mediocre performance,” she says.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Stand-in or not, huge job. Do great and industry bigwigs notice you, blah blah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Get logic, but eating my practice time for that? On top of that—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: “Ever since hanging around that trainer, lost your model edge.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Total crap! ...Ended up in huge fight. Ugh, absolute worst.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Get it, honestly. Focus slipping at gigs. Head stuck on running form instead of striking poses.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hit Tracen promising to keep modeling going. Manager pushed hard to make both work.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Put me in race though, fall flat on face. Seriously pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Figured running and modeling worked together. Guess not skilled enough after all...
Gold City stood in silence, looking dead serious while lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer. You truly believed I was an umamusume who could actually run, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not some decorative showpiece. Believed I can win on turf... right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Got it... ahaha... Decision made. Done. Should've done this way earlier.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Look so worried, super annoying. Tell you what, great news for you. Because I...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Quitting modeling entirely!
